name: Capital Gardens
summary: The Capital Gardens form the western wing of the ancient elven ruins of Dire Maul in Feralas. Once a serene, manicured park for the Kaldorei nobility, it has withered into a blighted woodland stalked by corrupted ancients, ghosts, and remnants of the Shen'dralar.

sections.title: A Decayed Sanctuary
sections.body: Ten millennia ago, Eldre'Thalas stood as one of the shining jewels of the Kaldorei empire. The Capital Gardens served as its outdoor district, lush with enchanted flora and grand marble terraces where Highborne sorcerers debated and relaxed. Following the Great Sundering, the enclave fell on desperate times. Deprived of the Well of Eternity, the resident Shen'dralar turned to dark magic to sustain their immortality, letting the gardens wither away. Today, gray, twisted boughs and corrupted treants fill the broken courtyards, while residual magical corruption prevents the forest from ever truly healing.

sections.title: The Athenaeum and the Prison
sections.body: Beyond the overgrown alleys and hostile ancients, the Capital Gardens connect deeper into the heart of the Shen'dralar redoubt. The paths lead directly to the Court of the Highborne and the Athenaeum—the preserved library holding centuries of arcane lore and forgotten treatises. Deeper still lies the Prison of Immol'thar, where the surviving elves bound a demon to siphon its power, an act of desperation that warped the surrounding gardens into the nightmare seen today.

faq.answer: The Capital Gardens is the western wing of Dire Maul, located within the ruins of Eldre'Thalas in central Feralas. It was once a pristine public park and residence for the city's Highborne elite.

faq.q: Why are the trees and ancients corrupted here?
faq.answer: After the Well of Eternity was destroyed, the surviving Shen'dralar sustained themselves by siphoning dark fel energies from a summoned demon, Immol'thar. The resulting leak of volatile magic slowly warped the local plant life and drove the resident ancients into violent madness.
The gardens lead deeper into the western complex of Dire Maul, opening into the Court of the Highborne, the scholarly Athenaeum, and the inner sanctuary holding the demon Immol'thar.

faq.q: Are there any friendly elves left in the gardens?
faq.answer: Most of the Highborne roaming the pathways are hostile spirits or maddened defenders. However, within the nearby Athenaeum, some Shen'dralar scholars still endure, willing to barter ancient knowledge or trade for lost elven librams.

angles.text: For the night elves, walking the blighted paving of the Capital Gardens is a harrowing reminder of Highborne hubris and the catastrophic costs of arcane addiction.
Despite the decay, the gardens house pathways toward the Athenaeum, one of the greatest repositories of pre-Sundering magical theory still standing in Kalimdor.
